newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: EC shifts wheat-only food aid policy in Bangladesh.
newsitem.headline: EC shifts wheat-only food aid policy in Bangladesh.

text.p: The European Union (EU) has begun giving cash, instead of just wheat, as food aid to Bangladesh under its new food security policy, commission officials in Dhaka said on Sunday.

The EU signed contracts with four non-government organisations on Sunday under which 6.7 million ECU (European Currency Units), or $7.31 million, is to be spent on social forestry and homestead cultivation in rural areas of Bangladesh.
"This is the first time that we have provided cash under our food security operations here," said Christian Romer, food security adviser at the EU office in Dhaka.

"The Bangladesh food market is fairly competitive now. People can buy any food at a competitive price in the open market. Also people do not eat only wheat, so cash aid will prove more effective security," he said.
EU officials said, however, that Bangladesh would also continue to get wheat as food aid.
The EU is one of Bangladesh's largest food aid donors, providing about 150,000 tonnes of wheat annually.
